name: EXM_EXPENSE_DISTS
description: This table is used to store distribution information for a specific expense line. The table is a multi-org table.

columns.name: EXPENSE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the expense distribution of a specific expense item.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense report which includes the expense corresponding to this distribution.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense for this distribution.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Sequence in which the distributions are created.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting code combination that expense is charged to.

columns.name: REIMBURSABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount to be reimbursed to the individual against this expense distribution.

columns.name: COST_CENTER
columns.description: Cost center that the expense needs to be charged to.

columns.name: PREPARER_MODIFIED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the expense preparer modified the account or project distribution.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
